title: Astra Automotive onramp — raw field jotter
content:
Context / quick summary:
- Intro call 2026-02-24 with Astra Automotive (edge deployments at Tier-1 supplier sites in DE). Customer wants a private inference deployment that can run locally in factory DMZs and optionally sync anonymized telemetry to Redwood hosted analytics.
- Priority: low latency interactive diagnostics (technician chat, guided troubleshooting) + batch QA synthesis overnight.
- Hard constraints: no PII leaves customer network, strict change window for installs (weekends), corporate firewall policy, on-prem approval takes ~6 weeks.

Notes from call (raw):
- They run on-prem VMware clusters currently; infra team would prefer an OVA or Helm chart for their K8s but are open to a small VM installer.
- Primary site: Wolfsburg plant, 1x DMZ gateway, 3 racks available for inference.
- Network: outbound only via approved proxy (TLS intercept) to limited hosts; anything that requires public egress needs security review.
- Security: HSM/KMS mandatory for key storage; they use HashiCorp Vault Enterprise (we will integrate with transit).
- Compliance: logs kept 12 months, audit access to prompts/outputs must be role-based and encrypted at rest.

Initial infra proposal (thinking aloud):
- Candidate hardware: 2 x NVIDIA H100 or 4 x L40S per site depending on cost. For interactive SLOs H100 better but more expensive.
- Model baseline: run a 13B open model quantized to Q4 or Q4f for interactive; keep a non-quantized 34B as fallback for low-volume critical flows.
- Runtime: Private package (air-gapped option) with local control plane + optional telemetry collector that pushes only aggregated metrics (no raw prompts).
- KV/prefix cache: enable prefix caching with TTL 10s for repeated diagnostic prompts, eviction policy LRU by session ID.
- Batching: continuous batching allowed for overnight jobs; interactive path must have batch size=1 and max latency budget 120ms P95 for responses up to 256 tokens.

Gotchas / risks flagged:
- Their proxy performs TLS interception and signs with corporate CA. Installer must allow custom trust store and cert pinning exceptions for local control-plane comms.
- Their SCCM team will block ports by default. Need an install checklist with exact ports: 22 (ops), 443 (control plane), 9090 (metrics), 50051 (gRPC inference) and a fallback to 443 multiplexing if SOC disallows extra ports.
- Vault integration: they run Vault in HA behind a service account; we must support AppRole flow and also ability to use sealed HSM via PKCS11.
- Air-gapped mode: they insisted on no internet at all in initial pilot. Need clear list of artifacts we ship and an offline install procedure + signatures.
- Model licensing: customer legal asked for list of model licenses (open-source and derivatives) and an indemnity note if we bake third-party weights into our image.

Open questions to resolve (priority order):
1) Hardware decision: H100 vs L40S — ask infra for TCO and procurement timeline. Who: Liam. Due: 2026-03-18.
2) Can telemetry be aggregated at edge and then pushed nightly to hosted analytics? Need written sign-off from security. Who: Priya to coordinate w/ customer security. Due: 2026-03-10 (urgent).
3) Offline installer packaging format preference (OVA vs tarball helm chart vs PXE image). Who: Maya to capture ops constraints. Due: 2026-03-05.
4) Exact ports allowed by SCCM + SOC — we need a firewall exception template. Who: Customer infra (contact: Jens Müller), internal owner: Liam. Due: 2026-03-04.
5) Model quantization policy acceptance: does customer accept slight quality drop for latency/cost gains? Need an example prompt set to run evals. Who: Maya + Customer PM. Due: 2026-03-12.

Action items (cuttable checklist):
- [ ] Draft offline install checklist + checksums/signatures for binary artifacts (Maya, 2026-03-02).
- [ ] Share model license inventory + short legal note (Priya, 2026-03-03).
- [ ] Prepare small latency experiment: run 13B q4f on L40S vs 13B q8 on H100 (runtime bench) (Eng infra, 2026-03-10).
- [ ] Assemble minimal telemetry contract: which metrics, frequency, redaction rules (Maya/Priya, 2026-03-08).
- [ ] Draft firewall exception template + port fallback plan (Liam, 2026-03-04).
- [ ] Produce an eval prompt set (50 prompts) that reflect technician flows for model quality gating (Customer + S.E., 2026-03-11).

Conversation snippets / useful quotes (for notes):
- Jens (infra): "We will not allow any puppet on our hypervisor — installer must be self-contained and human-operated."
- Security lead: "If you touch PII we need field revocation and provable data erasure APIs."
- PM: "Latency is a blocker for adoption — if the assistant is slow on the shop floor, technicians won't use it."

Quick decisions we can make now:
- Build an offline installer baseline and a KMS integration path for AppRole + PKCS11.
- Ship minimal telemetry that is aggregated counts + latencies, no prompts.
- Default to L40S for cost-conscious sites and propose an H100 trial at Wolfsburg if latency evals show big wins.

Notes for packaging team:
- Provide signed tarball and OVA variants. Include an 'airgap-install.md' with step-by-step and checksum verification. Make sure service account creation steps for Vault are clear.
- Installer must accept a custom CA bundle file at install time and be able to persist it to the OS trust store.

Customer contacts (record):
- Jens Müller, Infra Lead, jens.muller@astra-auto.de
- Petra Köhler, Security Architect, petra.kohler@astra-auto.de
- Lukas Weber, PM, lukas.weber@astra-auto.de

Follow-ups (calendar):
- Schedule technical deep-dive w/ on-prem ops + security 60m (aim for week of 2026-03-08). Owner: Maya to schedule.
- Internal sync with infra bench team before 2026-03-06 to set up hardware test matrix. Owner: Liam.

Rough timeline estimate (very provisional):
- Week 0–2: detailed requirements + signed telemetry contract + offline install artifacts
- Week 3–6: procurement & staging of hardware (if H100, add 2–4 weeks procurement)
- Week 7–9: onsite install window (weekend) + smoke tests
- Week 10–12: pilot evaluation & quality regressions check

Misc notes / fragments:
- Consider building a tiny local UI for firewall teams to approve certs during install (one-time wizard).
- Think about a "data minimization" toggle in console to disable any prompt storage at runtime for sites that require it.
- Add a canned rollback instruction that runs model fallback to small quantized runtime if heat or GPU OOM occurs.

End of jotter.

(Will clean up into a customer facing one-pager after items are resolved.)
